subtasks: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.
Use the right gripper to pick up the fallen tube beside the right edge of the rack and insert it upright into an empty large opening. Leave the seated center tube in place.
Lay the inverted right-hand tube on the right tabletop, regrasp it with the orange cap facing up during transport, and insert its tapered white tip into an empty large opening in the rack.
Use the left arm to pick up the loose tube on the left tabletop and insert it tip first, cap up, into an empty large opening on the left side of the rack. Release and return the open arms.
